slides.headline: A photo in, a toy out
body: With Creality’s CubeMe and SnapForm apps, kids turn a photo of the family dog, or their own drawing, into a model they can print.
No 3D modelling needed. An AI camera also watches each print.

slides.headline: Five layers of protection
body: A fully enclosed chamber, a door-open alert, a bed that doesn’t heat up, a carbon filter and low-odour PLA.
It prints up to 153 mm cubed, started from its own touchscreen.
